summary: Audited BRUNO reels feed and lives (Daily.co SFU) features. Backend: 5/5 pytest cases pass (full moderation flow including host/viewer tokens with p.cs/p.ca false, viewer field hiding, settings+blocked word 422, pin, mute/unmute, add_mod permissions (mod can pin but not settings), spam 429, kick→banned+403 join/comment, viewer end 403, host end+duration, viewer_count int + is_moderator flag). Feed endpoints verified: not-interested hides from recommended-videos and 404 for unknown, by-username resolves both 'Viewer Dos' and 'viewer_dos' to id 3636b29b..., reports POST 200, block hides author's posts from recommended-videos (unblocked to restore). Frontend: reels caption/author/follow-pill present (own reel has no pill as expected), description aria-expanded toggles, options sheet opens with reel-report-btn → reasons list → toast 'Reporte enviado...' ✓, not-interested & block buttons present, mentions/hashtag links routed. Host /lives/start: title input + go btn work; live-host-page renders with live-host-duration ticking and live-host-connection data-state='connected' (headless surprisingly connected to Daily); moderation sheet shows allow-comments toggle and blocked-words-input/save. Viewer /lives/{id}: live-viewer-page + follow(Siguiendo→Seguir persisted), share, report, comment-input all present; comment appears in overlay list. One frontend bug: reels scroll position is NOT restored after returning from /profile/:id (scrollTop resets to 0).

ui_bugs.issue: Position NOT restored on back-nav from /profile/:id — reels-scroller scrollTop resets to 0 and the active reel changes. Explicitly required by review request.

action_items: Fix FEED_CACHE/scroll-restore in /app/frontend/src/components/reels/useReelsFeed.js + ReelsPage.jsx: after returning from /profile/:id, reels-scroller.scrollTop should remain >0 and the previously active reel should still be visible without a refetch spinner.
critical_code_review_comments: lives.py `_blocked` enforces word-boundary (\b) with regex escape — if blocked word contains unicode or punctuation, \b may miss matches; acceptable for current scope.
lives.py spam rate limit uses `recent >= 3` → 429 triggers on the 4th message as specified. OK.
lives.py:496 `settings` action: when blocked_words is None we still $set an empty fields dict if allow_comments is also None → effectively a no-op update but still writes {}; acceptable.

LiveOverlay.jsx: `live-gifts-note` is only rendered when giftsOpen=true. Review wording 'Gifts panel shows live-gifts-note' matches this (visible only inside gifts panel) — not a bug, just note for next tester.

posts_feed.py /users/by-username: regex only matches exact username/name (case-insensitive) + underscores→spaces for name. 'viewerdos' (without underscore) would not resolve to id — matches scope since review only lists 'Viewer Dos' and 'viewer_dos'.
seed_data_creation: Transient test lives were created and ended; hidden_posts entry for one recommended post for host newtest remains (no cleanup endpoint — noted).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend chain is fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_lives_feed_iteration96.py (5 cases, all pass). Remaining to re-verify after fix: reels position restore. Two-browser viewer↔host realtime events (pin bar on both sides, mute toast on viewer, kick→live-kicked-page, end→live-ended-page) were NOT exercised through two parallel Playwright contexts; they are already covered functionally by backend tests + viewer UI render test. If main agent needs full E2E verification, run two Playwright contexts simultaneously. One lingering `hidden_posts` row exists for newtest from the not-interested test.
rca of the issue: Reels position-restore: ReelsPage returns to /reels after navigating to /profile/:id but useReelsFeed re-mounts cold; FEED_CACHE either (a) is not keyed with scroll offset, (b) is not read on mount, or (c) scroll is being reset by an effect after items are hydrated. Reproduction: login newtest → /reels → scroll to 2nd reel → tap reel-author-avatar (goes to /profile/:id) → browser back → reels-scroller.scrollTop === 0 (expected >0). Fix suggestion: persist {items, scrollTop, activeIndex} in FEED_CACHE on unmount/location change and on mount restore scrollTop via requestAnimationFrame after items render (avoid race with virtual list).
